quest.title: A Dish Beyond Mortal Ken
quest.description: Something seems to be bothering Wangshu Inn's Smiley Yanxiao...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Recipe: Chicken Tofu Pudding x1, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: *sigh* What should I do...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. Nothing's wrong... except I might need to start looking for a new job soon.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: The other day, the innkeeper asked me to prepare a new dish that would attract more guests.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: It should be presentable and tasty, but also stylish and artisan. Oh, and have personality...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I've been trying to come up with something satisfactory over the last week, but the innkeeper didn't like any dish I came up with.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What did you make?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I gave it all I had, really. I utilized everything I learned while honing my culinary skills in the mountains.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Candied Silk Flower, Qingxin and Lotus Seed Duck Stew, Crab Roe Stewed Meatballs...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: ...But he would shake his head at everything and ask me to give it another thought.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: But I've already reached my limit, eh...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Ah, right! I still gotta cook something for that freeloader. It's about time he came around...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you mean Jiangxue?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Unless you know of any other parasites who'd shamelessly come here every day asking for food...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Since you're already here, why don't you grab a bite too? You can sit over there. I'll serve the food when it's ready.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: You can sit by the table. I'll serve the food when it's ready.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: These meatballs are not half bad, this meat just melts in one's mouth, the broth packs a lot of flavor as well...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Huh? There's crab roe in the meat, no wonder it tastes so unusually fresh.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Come, Traveler, try one more. I'll teach you what to do. First, use chopsticks to open the meatball up, then soak it in the broth, and eat it with some rice...

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: You'd better enjoy the food because that might've been the last meal I got to cook here...

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: Last meal you got to cook here... Who told you so?

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: Oh no, is it because of me? Is the innkeeper fed up with you because you've been feeding me all this time?

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: Seems a bit unfair, given that I supplied the inn with some of my best catches free of charge. That should've covered at least a part of my bill. Besides, the innkeeper isn't known for being a miser...

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Give me a break, it was just a few fish, and most of them ended up in your stomach anyway.

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: So actually...

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: *sigh* ...Fine. I'll tell you...

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: Presentable, tasty, stylish, artisan, and with personality...

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: Hahaha, I'm not sure if there's any dish in this world that'd meet the innkeeper's requirements.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: You think it's funny? We'll see how you'll laugh when you come over next time and I won't be here to feed you for free!

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: Alright, alright, it's not so funny after all. So that's why you've been looking so worried today.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: It's hard to be in high spirits when your boss expects you to perform miracles all of a sudden...

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: Hm, there might be a way out. Even though I can't cook myself, I happen to know a recipe for a unique dish.

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: I came across that dish during a trip abroad, when I happened to be a guest at a local big shot's house. They called it Chicken Tofu Pudding.

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: By the looks of it, you wouldn't say that it's a meat dish. It really is as delicate as tofu pudding, but with a strong flavor of meat and herbs. A rare meat dish that imitates vegetarian cuisine.

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: That meal left me so curious about the dish that I asked my host for the recipe, however... I'm a bad cook, so the recipe has been collecting dust in my chest ever since...

choices.text: I'm surprised that you managed to get a hold of such a recipe.

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: Uh... Long story short, I helped someone, and they invited me to a feast to show their gratitude.

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: The chef who came up with this recipe didn't mind sharing it with me. He was confident that one can count the people skilled enough to make such a dish on one hand anyway.

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: No doubt about it. According to that chef, those who attempt to make the dish, have to be not only skilled in the art of cooking, but also in the art of the sword.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Hmph, what kind of a dish requires swinging a sword? I can chop meat just fine with my knife.

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: I'm afraid you'd sooner cut the chopping board in half than mince the meat fine enough with that knife of yours.

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: I was told that minced meat is the highlight of this dish.

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: As such, precise sword technique is the key to success. First, one needs to portion the meat and chop it up with the sword's edge. Then, use the sword's backside to mince it. Next...

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Hold on. Wait a minute... That recipe of yours is good for nothing in our hands. I'm not much of a swordsman, and you're not a cook.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Where can we find a sword-wielding warrior who also happens to have some culinary skills?

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: This person... might be closer than you think.

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: Precisely. Isn't it a fortunate twist of fate that you know how to use both the sword and the stove?

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: How about we let the Traveler attempt to make that unique dish?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But the innkeeper wanted Yanxiao to...

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: Well, the innkeeper only told Yanxiao to come up with a new dish. He didn't specify who had to cook it, so it's still an open question.

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: Am I right, chef?

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Ah... right! Your logic is sound!

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: But what ingredients do we need to make a Chicken Tofu Pudding?

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: Nothing special, really, just some Fowl, Ham, Bird Egg, and Snapdragon.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: ...Still have some Fowl and Ham stored in the kitchen, but... we're fresh out of Bird Eggs and Snapdragon...

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Had I known sooner, I wouldn't have made those Matsutake Scrambled Eggs...

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Traveler, can I count on you to bring me one of each?

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Once you find them, we'll work that Chicken Tofu Pudding out together.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Uh... Naturally, I'll make sure to repay you for your help... Thank you in advance.

choices.text: I know my way around the kitchen, that's true...

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: You're also a skilled swordsman, aren't you? I've witnessed some of your feats myself.

choices.text: Surely, it must be a very difficult dish...
Whoa, you talk like an expert...

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: Hahaha, even a fool would learn a thing or two about food if they got to eat such delicacies every day. Let me teach you the correct way to taste this stewed fish...

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Me? I'm afraid I'm already full... since the innkeeper filled me with anxiety.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Alright, we've got all the ingredients needed. Let's get to work.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Well... maybe our freeloading friend can provide us with some instructions?

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: Right. First, portion the meat on the table with your sword and slice it into smaller pieces. Then, mince it, slowly turning it into fine paste...

choices.text: So... What do you want me to do first?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: I've never expected that this recipe might actually come in handy, and yet...

talks.objective: Pour pure water into the cooking pot
Bring the stove up to temperature

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: First, portion the meat on the table with your sword and slice it into smaller pieces. Then, mince it, slowly turning it into fine paste...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Let me try...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Mmmm, this flavor... so rich and fresh, but the mouthfeel resembles that of a tofu pudding...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Looks quite presentable, too, and requires truly exquisite workmanship. The premise is also catchy — a meat dish that imitates vegetarian cuisine — I'm sure many would like to try it for themselves...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Not bad! Not bad at all! I'm sure it'll be to the innkeeper's taste.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: What a surprise! Turns out you're more capable than I gave you credit for. Who knew a sponger like you would remember this recipe so well.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Haha. I might as well tell you: back in the day, I thought that this recipe contained some sort of secret sword art, so I studied it day and night without ceasing...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Now that I think about it, I must have been an absolute madman. It was just a recipe, why would there be anything about swordsmanship in it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And all that practice, for...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: To look for someone and to ask for justice, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Hah! That was a magnificent deed! And here you are, speaking so softly about it.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Haha. Well, once I'd exacted that justice, I came here. Thankfully, the innkeeper was willing to take me in and let me loaf about the place.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: I am now free of desire. I no longer wish to wield my sword, nor do I have any other skills... Hahaha, I suppose staying here for the rest of my life isn't so bad.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Well now, I suppose I should give you a copy of this recipe. You can make it for yourself if you have the time. It's a little troublesome, but it tastes pretty good.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Hmm... Well, let's put this dish aside. We can show it to the innkeeper once he gets here.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: And after that... hey, hey, Mr. Loafer, don't you go anywhere just yet. Come over here.

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: Oh, what do you want? I don't have another recipe for you, just so you know.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Come on. Didn't you say that you didn't have any skills apart from wielding your sword? Well then, draw that sword, I'm teaching you to chop meat.

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: Chop meat? I... Well, I'm afraid...

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: You'll get it pretty quickly. Chop meat today, make a dish tomorrow. Learn yourself a few of those, and there, you've got a skill.

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: What are you...

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Hmph. A few dishes under your belt, yes — that'll spare me the need to watch you scrap for food around here, that's for sure.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Well, come on then, don't drag your feet. You dilly-dally some more, and you can forget having any meatballs to eat tomorrow!

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: Wait, what? Come on, you can't threaten me like that... Alright, alright, I'll chop them. I'll chop them!

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: Of course. I never get tired of our good chef's great food.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Huh? I see that we have a special guest today. Usually, it's just that chef and I, eating in silence. Perhaps your presence will liven up today's meal.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: But it appears that the chef is terribly worried about something today. Why the long face...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Have you found a Bird Egg and a Snapdragon?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I wonder how it will turn out. Hope it's tasty...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Okay, that's good, now pour some more water into this pot...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Hey chef, can you take care of this Ham and Snapdragon and make a pot of broth? Just remember to filter it carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Okay, okay, I'll do exactly that...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Okay, that's good, now pour some more water into this pot...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Hey chef, can you take care of this Ham and Snapdragon and make a pot of broth? Just remember to filter it carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Okay, okay, I'll do exactly that...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Now, light the stove up and slow-cook the meat paste.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: You have to keep the flame in check — too low and the meat won't cook through, too high and the paste will break up and lose its texture.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Slow-cooking the meat in a special broth... This dish is not a budget option, that's for sure...
